title: Jesse Jackson's Golden Leaf band and Arthur Williams
summary: Happy says the band was the Golden Leaf with Jesse Jackson as manager; he lists members including Bud Russo, Lee Collins and clarinetist Arthur Williams, who is still alive.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Well, that band was the Golden Leaf. And Jesse Jackson was the manager. And I played with Jesse on the arm. Long time. Long time. Long years. And it was me, Jesse Jackson. Bud Russo. And the big Collins. And Arthur. A little Arthur. What did Arthur play? He played clarinet.
A little Arthur? What else? Did he play any other instruments? No other instruments. Just clarinet? Yeah.
I don't know him. No, you know him. He is a little cross-eyed. Mm-hmm. Is he still alive? Oh, yeah. He's still alive. He's old. Arthur played with Tate Chambers. Sure he is old.
Oh, yeah. How old would Arthur be, I reckon?
Arthur. Arthur is older than I am. Arthur is around about the shield. Soon he's sitting there as old Arthur. You know where Arthur lives? No, I don't know where he lives. I seen him the other day.
I'd like to see him very much, you know, if he's that old.
Well, he lives up there around Willie Bontag. Oh. Willie Bontag can tell you where he lives.
Alright, well, we'll check into that. From Willie Bontag.
Yeah. You were just asking about Arthur Williams. About Arthur who? Arthur Williams.
Arthur Williams. Oh, I see. That's his name. Good. And what was Lee Collins playing at the time? Trumpet. And Bud Russel?
